appearances.title: Nod ships as an open-source personal agent with its own browser
appearances.summary: n8n Labs released Nod, an Apache 2.0 personal agent that runs on a Mac, Windows PC, or your own server and uses whichever model provider you choose. It has its own computer and browser for work across apps and websites, and can be reached from the desktop app, the web, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
